title: Law to protect grocery delivery workers from heavy loads
summary: This bill would bar third-party grocery delivery apps from requiring delivery workers to carry more than 22 pounds of goods in a single trip or to wear backpacks when delivering by bike, scooter or moped. It would let workers choose to make heavier deliveries or wear backpacks and would prohibit retaliation against those who exercise these rights, with penalties and a private right to sue for violations. The law would take effect 90 days after enactment.
